DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご自宅からその場所までは、どのくらい離れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: How far is that place from your home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩いて十分です。でも今の自宅ではなく、実家からの距離を話していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 距離を実家から説明していたと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ten minutes on foot. But I was describing the distance from my family home, not my current home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct your explanation to say the distance was from your family home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在お住まいの場所と、ご実家を分けて確認しましょう。出来事を見た時はどちらにいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us distinguish where you live now from your family home. Which were you at when you saw the incident?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 実家に泊まっていました。その時の近さを、今の住所からの距離のように話してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当日の滞在先と現在住所を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was staying at my family home. I described how close it was then as if it were the distance from my current address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish where you were staying that day from your current address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。現在の連絡先は、最初に記入した住所でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Is the address you first wrote down the correct current contact address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、最初の住所は今の自宅です。実家へ連絡されると家族が驚くので、まず私に連絡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人への連絡を先にしてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, the first address is my current home. My family would be surprised if you contacted their home, so please contact me first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to contact you first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご連絡の希望を記録します。実家の住所は出来事の位置確認に必要な範囲で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record your contact preference. We will ask for your family home's address only as needed to locate the incident.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。実家の道順を示しますが、連絡先を変更する意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実家の道案内は連絡先変更でないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will show the way to my family home, but that does not mean I am changing my contact address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that directions to your family home do not mean a change of contact address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在住所、滞在場所、出来事の場所をそれぞれ確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check your current address, where you stayed, and where the incident happened separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今の住所はそのまま、当日いたのは実家として記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在住所と当日の場所の記録を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please leave my current address as it is and record my family home as where I was that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the record of your current address and location that day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正しました。続いて出来事の場所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have corrected it. Next, let us check where the incident happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今回の宛先を確認できる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a document to confirm this destination address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一覧がありますが、ほかの人の名前や住所も載っています。全部をここで広げたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛先一覧の他人情報を公開したくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a list, but it also includes other people's names and addresses. I do not want to spread the whole thing out here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you do not want to expose other people's information in the address list. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の宛先が読めれば大丈夫です。ほかの部分を隠して見せられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is enough if we can read the address for this shipment. Can you show it with the other parts covered?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙を折ると、必要な郵便番号まで隠れてしまいます。別の紙で覆ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 折ると必要欄も隠れるため覆う方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: If I fold the paper, it also hides the postal code we need. May I cover it with another sheet instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about covering it because folding would also hide a necessary field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。必要な一行だけ見えるようにしてください。資料はお預かりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please leave only the one necessary line visible. We will not keep the document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この行です。名前と住所を読みながら送り状へ写します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象行を示し転記する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. It is this line. I will read the name and address while copying them onto the shipping label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the relevant line and copy it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 転記した内容を、ご自身でも元の一行と照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also compare what you copied with the original line yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 照合できました。一覧は持ち帰ります。送り状だけをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元資料を持帰り送り状だけ渡すと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked them. I will take the list home and give you only the shipping label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will take the original document home and hand over only the shipping label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらに一覧の写しを残す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We do not need to keep a copy of the list here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。ほかの宛先は見せず、この一件だけで差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回一件のみ差出すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will send just this one parcel without showing the other addresses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will send only this one shipment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今回の送り状を確認しました。荷物と一緒にお受けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have checked this shipping label. We will accept it with the parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのサービスも利用できます。今お申し込みになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You can use this service too. Would you like to apply now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手数料の説明をまだ全部理解できていません。今日決めずに持ち帰って考えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 費用を理解するまで申込を保留したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have not fully understood the fee explanation yet. May I take the information home and think about it rather than decide today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to put the application on hold until you understand the costs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: もちろんです。どの利用を予定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Of course. How are you planning to use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 月に一回使うかどうかです。利用しない月にも費用がかかるのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 少ない利用頻度と固定費の疑問を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Perhaps once a month or less. I want to know whether there are fees even in months when I do not use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your low usage frequency and question about fixed costs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この条件表で、固定の費用と利用ごとの費用を分けてご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Using this conditions table, we will explain fixed fees separately from fees for each use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。説明を聞いたことが申込みの同意になるわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明を聞くことと同意を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Listening to the explanation does not count as agreeing to apply, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish listening to an explanation from consent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。今日は説明だけです。お申し込みには別途確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. Today is only an explanation. Applying requires a separate confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 安心しました。この条件表に、自分が確認したい箇所を印して持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件表に確認箇所を印して持帰ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: That is a relief. I will mark the parts I want to check on this conditions table and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will mark points to check on the conditions table and take it home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご不明な点は改めてご相談ください。今日の説明資料はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask us again about anything unclear. Here are today's explanatory materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。利用回数と費用を比べてから、必要なら申込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用回数と費用の比較後に判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will compare how often I will use it with the costs and apply if needed afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will decide after comparing usage frequency and costs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日はお申し込みを行っていません。資料をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: No application has been made today. Please take the materials with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品はすべて配送のご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like all these products delivered?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 牛乳だけ今夜使います。ほかは届けてほしいので、牛乳まで箱に入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 牛乳を配送箱へ入れないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will use the milk tonight. I want the others delivered, so please do not put the milk in the box too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask them not to put the milk in the delivery box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配送分とお持ち帰り分を分けますね。ほかに今日必要な物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will separate the delivery items from those you are taking home. Is there anything else you need today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: パンも持ち帰ります。この二つを同じ袋にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: パンも持帰り袋へ分けてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will take the bread home too. Please put those two in the same bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you also want the bread separated into the take-home bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。配送の利用条件を確認してから受付します。ご自宅で受け取れる日時はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. We will check the delivery conditions before accepting the request. When can you receive it at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日の午後なら家にいます。日時を指定できるか分からないので、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在宅日時を示し配送指定の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will be home tomorrow afternoon. I do not know whether I can specify the date and time, so I would like to ask first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the time you will be home and ask whether delivery scheduling is possible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が確認します。希望どおりの日時にできない場合は、配送分も含めて方法を決め直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check. If we cannot arrange your requested date and time, please reconsider how to handle the items, including those for delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。条件を聞く前に全部の会計を済ませないで、配送分の判断を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配送条件の確認前に確定会計しないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Please do not finalize payment for everything before I hear the conditions. I will wait to decide about the delivery items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask not to finalize checkout before confirming the delivery conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持ち帰る二品は確定ですね。ほかの商品は担当の確認後に進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The two take-home items are definite, correct? We will proceed with the other products after the staff member checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。牛乳とパンは持ち帰り、残りは受取条件を確認してから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持帰り確定品と配送検討品を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will take the milk and bread home and decide about the rest after checking the receiving conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the confirmed take-home items from those still under consideration for delivery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二品を分けました。配送担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have separated the two items. I will pass you on to the delivery staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この先は行事の参加者が並んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Event participants are lining up ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつもの周回コースです。走って列の間を通れば練習を続けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 練習経路上の列を走って抜けられるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my usual loop course. Could I keep training by running through the gaps in the line?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can run through the line on your training route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 列へ割り込んだり、人の間を走ったりしないでください。今日は別の通り方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not cut into the line or run between people. We will show you another way through today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分の距離の記録が切れるのが気になっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記録継続へのこだわりを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I was worried about interrupting my distance record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your concern about keeping your tracking uninterrupted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録より安全を優先してください。こちらの脇道なら歩いて移動できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please put safety before your record. You can use this side path on foot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 脇道も走れるコースなのかと思いました。ここは歩いて抜けるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 脇道も歩行区間か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought the side path was also a running route. So I should walk through here, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the side path is also a walking-only section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。行事区画を出てから、走れる場所を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. After leaving the event area, please check where you may run.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では計測を一度止めます。抜けた先で再開しても、同じ距離だったとは記録しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 計測を止め元の距離と混ぜないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will pause the tracking. Even if I restart after passing through, I will not record it as the same distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will pause tracking and not mix it with the original distance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それで結構です。列の後ろを横切る時も係員の案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is fine. Please follow staff directions when crossing behind the line too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。ここでは止めて歩き、行事の外で練習を再開します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 歩いて区画を抜け再開すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will stop here and walk, then resume training outside the event area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will walk out of the area and then resume. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらへどうぞ。人の流れが落ち着いてからお通りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: This way, please. Please wait until the flow of people has eased before passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 時刻表のどの便をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which service are you looking for on the timetable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が九時に電話すると言っています。この九時着の便なら、着いた時に話せると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 到着時刻と家族の通話時刻を同じ九時で比べたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family says they will call at nine. If I take this service arriving at nine, I think I can talk when I arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you compared the arrival time and family call time as the same nine o'clock. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族はどちらにいらっしゃいますか。電話の九時も、こちらと同じ時刻か確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where is your family? Have you checked whether nine o'clock for the call is the same time as here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 海外にいます。メッセージには九時とだけあり、どちらの国の時刻か聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族が海外にいて時刻の基準は未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are overseas. The message only says nine, and I have not asked which country's time they mean.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your family is overseas and the time reference is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 駅の時刻表はこちらの時刻です。ご家族の約束と比べる前に、どちらの時刻で話しているか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The station timetable uses the time here. Before comparing it with your family arrangement, please confirm which time zone they mean.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 聞いてみます。家族の現地で九時だそうです。この場面では、そちらはここより一時間遅いと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族に表示基準を確認し場面の時差を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask. They mean nine in their local time. In this situation, they say their time is one hour behind here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the time reference with your family and explain the time difference in this situation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その条件ならこちらの十時に当たりますね。九時着の便で移動して、通話までの時間も取る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Under those conditions, that would be ten here. Are you planning to take the service arriving at nine and leave time before the call too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。九時着の後に移動し、こちらの十時に電話します。家族には向こうの九時だと添えて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅到着と通話時刻を分け双方の時刻を添えて返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will travel onward after arriving at nine and call at ten here. I will confirm with my family, adding that it is nine where they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish station arrival from the call time and reply giving both local times. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 移動中に予定が変わる場合は、連絡にもどちらの時刻か付けてください。こちらの便の運行は表示で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your plans change while traveling, please specify which local time you mean in your message too. You can check this train's operation on the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族との通話は双方の時刻で確認し、列車は駅の表示の九時着の便を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 列車は駅表示で選び通話は両地域の時刻で合意すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will confirm the call using both local times, and choose the train arriving at nine according to the station display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will choose the train by the station display and agree on the call using both regions' times. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらがその便の乗場です。到着予定と通話の約束を別々にお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the platform for that service. Please check the expected arrival and the call arrangement separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 勤務先とのお話は、どの程度進んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: How far have your discussions with your workplace progressed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社も賛成していると思います。上司が「考えておく」と言っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 上司の検討発言を同意と捉えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I think the company agrees too. My supervisor said, 'I will think about it.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you interpreted your supervisor's statement about considering it as agreement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その言葉だけで同意が決まったとは言えません。ご本人が直接確認した範囲を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Those words alone do not establish agreement. Please tell me what you have directly confirmed yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 確かに、許可するとは言われていません。自分の希望を伝えただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 許可を得ておらず希望のみ伝えたと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's true; they did not say they would approve it. I only told them what I wanted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your explanation to say that you have not obtained permission and only stated your wishes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では会社の返答待ちとして整理しましょう。今回ここで相談したいことは何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us record it as awaiting the company's reply. What would you like to discuss here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返事を待つ間に、相談できる支援の種類を知りたいです。会社を代表して申請するわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返答待ち中の個人向け支援を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: While waiting for the reply, I want to learn what types of support I can ask about. I am not applying on behalf of the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about support for individuals while waiting for the reply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 個人として利用できる相談先をご案内します。会社の確認が必要な条件は別にお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will show you services you can consult as an individual. We will explain separately any conditions requiring confirmation from the company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。会社名を書く欄があっても、会社の同意があるという意味にはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先情報と会社同意を区別するよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Even if there is a field for the company name, please do not treat that as meaning I have company consent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to distinguish workplace information from company consent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。勤務先情報と同意の有無を区別して確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will check workplace information separately from whether consent has been given.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。会社の返答は未確定で、今日は自分の相談として進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個人相談と未確定の返答を再確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. The company's reply is not final, and today I will proceed as my own consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reconfirm that this is an individual consultation and the reply is not yet final. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で記録します。利用目的から順に伺いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will record that. Let us start by asking your purpose for using the support.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 前に出されたお薬は、指示どおり飲めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you been taking the medicine previously prescribed as directed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最初は飲みましたが、錠剤が大きくて、その後は飲めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 錠剤の大きさで服用できていないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took it at first, but the tablets are large and I have not been able to take them since.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have not been able to take the medicine because of the tablet size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 飲めなかった状況を担当に伝えます。いつから、どの薬が飲めていないか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will tell the staff member about the difficulty taking it. Do you know which medicine you have not taken and since when?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三日前からです。忘れたのではなく、飲み込むのが難しくて残しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 期間と飲忘れとの違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: For the last three days. It was not that I forgot; I left it because it was difficult to swallow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the period and distinguish it from forgetting doses. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 残っている薬や袋はお持ちですか。ご自身で砕いたり量を変えたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you brought the remaining medicine or its bag? Have you crushed it or changed the dose yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋があります。砕こうか迷いましたが、まだ何も変えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬袋を提示し自己変更していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the bag. I considered crushing it, but I have not changed anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the medicine bag and say that you have not changed it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自己判断で変更せず、医療者に相談してください。飲み込みにくさについても確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consult a medical professional rather than changing it on your own. We will also check the swallowing difficulty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。叱られると思って全部飲んだと言いかけましたが、実際の残りを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 服用済みと言いかけたが残量を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I nearly said I had taken it all because I thought I would be scolded, but I will tell you what is actually left.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you nearly claimed to have taken it but will report the remaining amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その方が状態を確認できます。ここでは飲み方を変える判断はできませんので、担当に引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will help us assess the situation. We cannot decide here to change how you take it, so we will refer it to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。飲めていない期間と残った薬を見せ、別の方法があるか診察で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正確な服用状況を医療者へ相談すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will show how long I have not taken it and the medicine remaining, and ask during the consultation whether there is another way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will give medical staff an accurate account of your medicine use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ伝えました。袋を持って診察をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have informed the staff member. Please wait for your consultation with the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お客様は相手の方とどのような関係ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What is your relationship with the other person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 関係はありません。通りがかりに口論を見たので、自分がけんかした話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 無関係の目撃者だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have no relationship with them. I saw an argument while passing by; this is not about a fight I was involved in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are an unrelated witness. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 目撃された内容ですね。最初から見ていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So this is what you witnessed. Did you see it from the beginning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 途中からです。声が大きかったので振り向きましたが、始まった理由は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 途中から見たため原因不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only from partway through. I turned around because the voices were loud, but I do not know why it started.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know the cause because you saw it only from partway through. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どなたが何をしたか、見た範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me who did what, within what you actually saw.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い服の人が手を動かしました。でも人が重なって、相手に触れたかは見えませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手の動きと接触の未確認を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The person in blue moved their hand. But people overlapped in my view, so I could not see whether they touched the other person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the hand movement from the unconfirmed contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 触れたと断定せず記録します。聞こえた言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record it without asserting that contact occurred. Were there any words you heard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つだけ覚えていますが、誰の声かまでは分かりません。その区別も書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 聞いた語と声の主の不明を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I remember just one word, but I do not know whose voice it was. Please record that distinction too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the word you heard from not knowing who spoke. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今も現場にいる方がいるか、分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Do you know whether anyone is still at the scene?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私が離れた時は二人ともいました。今もいるとは言えません。場所と離れた時刻を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 退出時の状況と現在の不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both people were there when I left. I cannot say they are still there now. I will give you the location and the time I left.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the situation when you left and that the current situation is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できた範囲を伺いました。場所を地図で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have heard what you could confirm. Let us check the location on a map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 海外への荷物です。配送方法をご相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is an overseas parcel. Would you like to discuss the delivery method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 航空便なら、私が明日乗る飛行機に一緒に載せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の搭乗便に載せられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: If I choose airmail, can you put it on the same flight I am taking tomorrow?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether it can be sent on your own flight. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様の搭乗便へ指定して載せるサービスではありません。郵便の差出しとご自身の旅行は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is not a service that lets you specify your own flight for the parcel. Posting mail and your own travel are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでしたか。空港で私が荷物を受け取るつもりでしたが、それも違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空港での本人受取と思った誤解を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I intended to collect the parcel myself at the airport, but that is not how it works either, is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your misunderstanding that you would collect it yourself at the airport. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通常は宛先への配送です。旅先で受け取る予定なら、その住所で受け取れるか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is normally delivered to the address. If you plan to receive it at your destination, please check whether it can be received at that address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族の家で受け取ります。私の到着日より遅くなる可能性も伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族宅で受け取り到着差を知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will receive it at my family's home. I will also tell them it may arrive after my own arrival date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will receive it at your family's home and inform them of the possible difference in arrival dates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 到着予定は目安で、搭乗時刻と同じにはできません。中身と送付先を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The expected arrival is only an estimate and cannot be matched to your flight time. Let us check the contents and destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 衣類です。旅行で携帯する分は分けて、届くまで必要な物は自分で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発送品と手元に必要な衣類を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Clothing. I will separate what I am taking on the trip and carry what I need until the parcel arrives myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate clothes being sent from the clothes you need to keep with you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように分けたうえで、荷物の内容を記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After separating them that way, please fill in the parcel contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分の便には指定せず、家族の住所へ衣類を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 便指定でなく住所宛の発送を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will send clothes to my family's address without specifying my own flight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm shipping to an address rather than specifying a flight. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では宛先と内容を確認して配送方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check the destination and contents and explain the delivery methods.
